description: This file defines interrupt allocation flags, function prototypes, and constants for managing interrupts on the ESP32C3 platform within the Zephyr RTOS environment.

methods.name: esp_intr_initialize
methods.description: Initializes the interrupt table to its default state.

methods.name: esp_intr_alloc
methods.description: Allocates an interrupt with specified source, flags, handler, and optional handle.

methods.name: esp_intr_get_enabled_intmask
methods.description: Returns a bitmask of currently enabled interrupt sources.
